role: Declares the first-person hand pass and its inputs: the held item as the paths branch on it (raster_hand_item), the per-frame client state (raster_hand_in), the recorded-scene entry and the item table and RGBA loaders the live client uses.

structs.name: raster_hand_item
structs.java: ItemRenderer.itemToRender reduced to what the render paths branch on: icon uv per pass, tint, getItemUseAction, getMaxItemUseDuration, shouldRotateAroundWhenRendering, Block.getRenderColor

structs.name: raster_hand_in
structs.java: the client player's interpolation inputs for renderHand: rotation, EntityPlayerSP's arm angles, equippedProgress, swingProgress, getItemInUseCount, the light at the player

notes: HAND_USE_* mirror EnumAction's ordinals. Included by raster.c, raster_hand.c and play/play.c. lane/entrender: raster_hand_item.eff, raster_hand_in.glint and now.
